_what_this_is: The durable floors for the two counters tools/next_ids.py allocates.
That tool takes max(every phase or finding number it finds in the
documents, in docs/, and in the open pull requests; these floors) + 1.
The floors exist so a number claimed by a pull request that was later
closed without merging is never handed out a second time. Nothing writes
this file automatically: bump a floor by hand, in the commit that retires
the numbers below it, when no document or pull request mentions it any more.

history.what: Phase 134 and finding 139 documented cross-axis alignment: a flex line now takes the container's inner cross size when it is alone in a container of definite height (CSS Flexbox §9.4, with `align-content: stretch` as the default), so `align-items` finally has a size to align in and to stretch into; a column container's cross axis is the width; and a grid item is given the height of the rows it spans. Six reftests were added and three recorded ones lost their `known_failure` entries (34 pages, 121 assertions). Two neighbouring gaps found on the way were left as rows, each with a failing page: `justify-content` in a column container, and `align-self`/`align-content`. The floors are unchanged.

Phase 126 and finding 131 documented `DataView` — sixteen `get`/`set` methods over a buffer with the byte order named per call — and the thirteen methods `%TypedArray%.prototype` was missing (`at`, `map`, `filter`, `forEach`, `some`, `every`, `find`, `findIndex`, `reduce`, `reduceRight`, `sort` with a numeric default, `toSorted`, `toReversed`, `with`). The same file gained one script object per buffer without a process-lifetime registry: the buffer's data names its object and every view marks it through `JsExotic::trace`. `join` prints `NaN`. The floors are unchanged.

Phase 117 and finding 122 documented cookies on the WebSocket upgrade: the RFC 6455 request carries what `CookieJar` holds for the same URL with `ws` matched as `http` and `wss` as `https`, the page URL is the site for cookies, and a `Set-Cookie` on the `101` is stored before the upgrade is validated (`make security-websocket`, 32/32). The floors are unchanged: the open pull requests still name the numbers above them.

Phase 95 and finding 101 documented `document.write()` writing into the parser that called it: the tree builder can be re-entered at its insertion point (`write_into_parser`), the dump path runs the page's scripts as the parser reaches them, and the parser no longer inserts a second element or any text into a document. Five of the six `scripted_*.dat` cases pass. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

Phase 91 and finding 97 documented iterator kinds: a prototype per kind of iterator carrying the kind's one `next` and a `Symbol.toStringTag`, one function object for `Map.prototype.entries` and its `@@iterator` (and for `Set`'s `values`/`keys`/`@@iterator`), and the iteration fast path asking the prototype whether `next` is still the installed function before reading elements directly. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

Phase 88 and finding 94 documented private fields, methods and accessors as identities a class mints when it is evaluated, kept in a table no string key reaches. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

Phase 80 and finding 86 recorded the four direct-eval semantic repairs: optional eval calls are indirect, inherited super syntax is checked before source runs, sloppy eval vars target the function variable environment, and named function-expression self names are immutable. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

Phase 79 and finding 85 documented animated WebP: the ANMF frame walk and the canvas compositor, byte-identical to libwebp's animation decoder. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

Phase 75 and finding 81 documented observable Map/Set constructor dispatch through instance set/add methods. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.
Phase 68 and finding 74 documented bounded Map/Set iterator cursor cleanup. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.
Phase 66 and finding 72 documented ES-module workers and structured-clone message packets. The floors now preserve those allocated identifiers even if their documents or pull request later disappear.

tools/next_ids.py added, so an agent no longer reads ARCHITECTURE.md and AUDIT.md to work out two integers. New phase write-ups and findings move to docs/phases/ and docs/findings/; the two documents are frozen as append targets.
